subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw add captionedFinalText as a channel capability and make Telegram use captioned final-mode TTS by default for the linked final-mode churn bug?
rationale: The patch expands plugin-facing channel capability surface and changes Telegram delivery shape for existing final-mode TTS users, which is a maintainer product/API decision separate from the narrow code bug.

options.title: Approve capability-gated Telegram default
options.body: Proceed with this API shape after the ACP cancellation bug is fixed and current-head Telegram proof covers the visible and fallback paths.

options.title: Require explicit delivery mode
options.body: Pause this PR and ask for a user-facing design that lets users choose captioned voice versus separate text-plus-voice delivery.

options.title: Defer the SDK seam
options.body: Keep the linked issue open until maintainers design a narrower channel capability or Telegram-specific path.

recommendation.title: Approve capability-gated Telegram default
recommendation.body: Proceed with this API shape after the ACP cancellation bug is fixed and current-head Telegram proof covers the visible and fallback paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal for the ACP finalization and Telegram capability surfaces is the recent commit 42e2390b31.
